findings.desc: experiments/multi-model-ablation/m1-freeze-check.mjs:149 hard-requires optional cell ④ to exist, and lines 157/160-162/171 also hard-require ④ count and ③-vs-④ metadata. CHK-004 edge says the checker should permit missing optional ④ while still requiring ③/⑥/②, so a required-only valid matrix would fail as a brittle false positive. severity: medium

CHK-004:edge:0 and CHK-002:edge:0 claim optional ④ may be absent / the checker permits missing optional ④, but experiments/multi-model-ablation/m1-freeze-check.mjs:149-162 requires ④ to exist, requires optionalCellNumbers=[④], and requires requiredPlusOptionalRows=4608. Current evidence therefore does not cover the required optional-④-absent edge case.
